versions.name: Bears Afloat

provenance.notes: Name, rank placement and category from the official rank adventure pages. The evergreen description is original prose regenerated from the adventure's own 'Snapshot' section, excluding requirement text.

versions.description: A Bear explores paddle craft like canoes, kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards, learning the parts of a paddle, how to fit and wear a life jacket, and how to paddle safely on calm water.
